page.overview:
What is Erumalu?

Erumalu was a town located in the Arabasta Kingdom. Once called the , this town was ravaged by the encroaching sea and the extended drought, the latter caused by Crocodile's use of Dance Powder. The inhabitants have long since fled and the buildings are falling apart.

Erumalu was located to the western edge of the Sandora River, southeast of Yuba and east of the Spiders Cafe. Suiren, another ruined town, was located somewhere close to it.

Erumalu is currently nothing more than half-buried crumbled buildings and dead trees, with some skulls laying around the sand. There was once a canal that distributed rainwater around the city, but the constant drought created by Mr. 0 and the Dance Powder eventually caused the water reserves to dry up. According to Vivi, Erumalu used to be much richer in plant life.

It was home to the , according to Miss All Sunday.
